verdict.rationale: gitlab-docs-1 claims agents can 'review code while your team stays in control,' indicating an AI reviewer capability exists, but there is no evidence detailing how to assign initial code review specifically to an AI reviewer on a merge request, turnaround-time claims, or hands-on/community corroboration of this workflow. Missing for 10: documentation of the assignment mechanism for AI review on MRs, evidence of speed/turnaround benefits, and independent confirmation the feature works as described.
